item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Vernell Brown III carries on three-generation Florida Gators football legacy
item.description: The Gainesville native and wide receiver is entering his sophomore season wearing jersey No. 1 after leading the Gators in receptions as a freshman.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Carly Simon has been diagnosed with Parkinson's disease, treated for skin cancer
item.description: "You're So Vain" singer Carly Simon has been diagnosed with Parkinson's disease and was recently treated for skin cancer, the singer shared in a statement provided to The Associated Press.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Wife of Chiefs OC Eric Bieniemy shot near Washington DC; son in custody
item.description: The wife of Kansas City Chiefs offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy was shot Sunday night outside Washington, D.C. Bieniemy's son is in custody.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Federal officials investigate after a video appears to show a person kicking a California sea lion
item.description: Federal wildlife authorities are investigating after a video appeared to show a person kicking a protected sea lion at a beach in California.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: hurricane] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Genevieve becomes Category 5 hurricane; not expected to make landfall
item.description: Genevieve became a Category 5 hurricane early Monday, the first in the East Pacific region in two years, forecasters said.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] FAA issues ground stop for flights headed to TPA due to thunderstorms
item.description: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) issued a ground stop for flights headed to Tampa International Airport (TPA) on Monday morning due to thunderstorms.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] US-Iran strikes remain paused, but Trump warns of further escalation
item.description: The U.S. paused strikes on Iran — but it may not be over. Here's what VP Vance and the top U.S. general told President Trump, and what Iran is now saying about Ukraine.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Rescues in Action: Chocolate, Groban and Stoney
item.description: Chocolate, a 6-year-old Chocolate Lab has two speeds: full throttle and cuddle mode, Groban is the perfect little companion looking for a patient home to call his own, and Stoney is a brilliant, snuggly boy.
